findings.finding: read authorization builds Message changesets for broadcast/presence, inserts those rows, sets role/realtime.topic/JWT session configuration, then SELECTs the inserted message ids under RLS
set_conn_config writes role, realtime.topic, request.jwt.claims, request.jwt.claim.sub, request.jwt.claim.role and request.headers
realtime.messages authorization rows have topic and extension, with extension enum values broadcast/presence
upstream defines authenticated_read_presence_for_sub using realtime.topic(), realtime.messages.extension='presence' and SELECT auth.uid() in one SELECT policy
upstream integration coverage uses authenticated_read_presence_for_sub for private Presence and expects the matching JWT sub member to receive Presence while a different sub is denied

comparisonToDokeR3H.interpretation: The observed Doke staging behavior conflicts with the pinned upstream authorization source/tests. This is evidence of a parity/evaluation-context gap, not proof of a generic Supabase Presence defect.
